// d:/projects/prismo/src/lib/youtube/transcript.ts

export interface TranscriptItem {
    timestamp: string;
    text: string;
}

export interface TranscriptOptions {
    lang?: string; // Language code, default 'en'
}

/**
 * Fetches the auto-generated transcript of a YouTube video
 * by calling the yt-dlp backend service on Render.
 * Returns parsed transcript items (timestamp + text) or null if unavailable.
 */
export async function fetchTranscript(
    videoId: string,
    options?: TranscriptOptions
): Promise<TranscriptItem[] | null> {
    if (!videoId || videoId.length !== 11) {
        throw new Error("Invalid video ID");
    }

    const lang = options?.lang ?? "en";
    const backendUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL;

    if (!backendUrl) {
        console.error("NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is missing in environment variables");
        return null;
    }

    try {
        console.log(`Fetching transcript from backend for video: ${videoId}`);

        const response = await fetch(`${backendUrl}/transcript`, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ videoId, lang }),
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
            const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
            console.error("Backend transcript error:", response.status, errorData);
            return null;
        }

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!data.transcript || data.transcript.length === 0) {
            console.log(`No transcript available for video: ${videoId}`);
            return null;
        }

        console.log(`Received ${data.itemCount ?? data.transcript.length} transcript items`);
        return data.transcript as TranscriptItem[];
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("Transcript Fetch Error:", err);
        return null;
    }
}
